MUTUAL NON-DISCLOSURE AGREEMENT

This Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (this "Agreement") is entered into as of 14 February 2027 (the "Effective Date") by and between Halden Optics Corporation, a corporation with its principal place of business at 4400 Beacon Ridge Parkway, Suite 250, Charlotte, North Carolina 28209 ("Discloser"), and Verrant Systems B.V., a company with its registered office at Keizersgracht 412, 1016 GC Amsterdam, the Netherlands ("Recipient"). Discloser and Recipient are each a "Party" and together the "Parties".

1. Purpose. The Parties wish to evaluate a potential commercial relationship concerning inspection optics for semiconductor metrology.

2. Confidential Information. "Confidential Information" means all non-public information disclosed by a Party to the other Party, whether disclosed orally, in writing, or by inspection of tangible objects.

3. Exclusions. Confidential Information does not include information that (a) is or becomes publicly available through no fault of the Receiving Party; (b) was rightfully known to the Receiving Party prior to disclosure; or (c) is independently developed without use of the Confidential Information.

4. Term. The obligations in this Agreement survive for five (5) years from the Effective Date.

5. Notices. All notices must be sent to the following, and are effective on receipt:

If to Discloser: Halden Optics Corporation, Attn: Marguerite Delacroix-Reyes, General Counsel, 4400 Beacon Ridge Parkway, Suite 250, Charlotte, North Carolina 28209, email mdelacroix@haldenoptics.com, telephone +1 (704) 555-0148.

If to Recipient: Verrant Systems B.V., Attn: Joost van der Meer, Managing Director, Keizersgracht 412, 1016 GC Amsterdam, the Netherlands, email j.vandermeer@verrant.nl, telephone +31 20 555 0193.

6. Governing Law. This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of New York, without regard to its conflict of laws principles. Any dispute will be resolved by binding arbitration administered by JAMS in New York County.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Parties have executed this Agreement as of the Effective Date.

HALDEN OPTICS CORPORATION
By: Marguerite Delacroix-Reyes
Title: General Counsel
Date: 14 February 2027

VERRANT SYSTEMS B.V.
By: Joost van der Meer
Title: Managing Director
Date: 14 February 2027

notes: Baseline English NDA with no AMOUNT, which checks that a model does not invent one. Discloser and Recipient are quoted defined terms, not organization names. The company names also appear in all-caps in the signature block, which the strict matcher folds to the same key. New York appears only as governing law and venue, so it is a negative, while both street addresses are gold.
